$comment: Prototype for illustration only: not a production or scale-tested contract.
title: Journey Builder → activity: POST /ca/{sync|async}/execute (decoded JWT payload)
description: Body Journey Builder sends per contact. With useJwt=true the HTTP body is a compact HS256 JWT string signed with the installed package JWT Signing Secret; this schema describes the decoded payload. Journey Builder may add fields; consumers must ignore unknown properties.

inArguments.description: Array of single-key objects, already data-bound (no {{ }} left). Flatten with Object.assign({}, ...inArguments).

keyValue.description: Contact key of the contact in the journey.
